data.title: 烧盐柠檬 · 晨曦微光中的元气依恋温存
data.description: 清晨金辉洒在白被单上。小麦色的健康美腿与你交缠，短发微乱的烧盐柠檬像只晒饱太阳的小鹿般，把脸深深埋在你的胸口，带着幸福的甜笑抱紧你不放，咕哝着不想起床。
data.location: sunlit morning bedroom with bright white sheets
data.action: 像只晒饱太阳的小鹿般，把脸深深埋在你的胸口，带着幸福的甜笑抱紧你不放，咕哝着不想起床
data.lighting: bright golden morning sunshine warming bare skin and white sheets
data.promptProse: Wrapped lazily in tangled white morning sheets across the sunlit bedroom bed, Lemon wears her soft ribbed white tank top and grey lounge shorts as she curls tightly against her partner. Burying her flushed face happily against his chest with a sleepy, blissful smile and tousled short hair, she clings close while golden morning sunshine streams warmly over her bare tanned shoulders and crisp linens.
data.animaCaption: Tangled in sunlit white morning sheets in her ribbed white tank top and lounge shorts, Lemon buries her face warmly against her partner's chest with a sleepy, blissful smile. Golden morning sunshine bathes her bare tanned shoulders and rumpled pillows.
data.nsfwProse: Tangled under crisp white morning sheets in her ribbed white cotton tank top and grey lounge shorts, her tanned bare shoulders and bare legs press close against her partner.
